_note: Built for v5.10 (PLID-style multiple descriptions): for each disease, the distinct visual descriptions from disease_descriptions_v1 (short), disease_descriptions_long_v1 (long) and disease_descriptions_contrastive_v1 (contrastive rewrites for 33 near-duplicate diseases; the rest equal v1), deduplicated, in that order.
